newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 POSTS FIRST GAIN IN EIGHT SESSIONS.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 POSTS FIRST GAIN IN EIGHT SESSIONS.

text.p: Czech major issues rebounded on Friday helping the PX50 index on to its first gain in eight sessions.
The PX50 rose 2.4 points, 0.41 percent, to 583.7 while the major issue dominated RPIX moved 15.5 points higher, 1.27 percent, to 1,231.9.

All four of the PX50's major issues, accounting for 51 percent of the index's capitalisation, posted moderate to strong gains ending a sustained downturn which has seen them lose nearly five percent of their value in the last week alone.
Dealers said the sharp bear run on Czech major issues had made for some relatively cheap buys. Referring to SPT Telecom , which rose 65 crowns to 3,710, Ivo Suchy of ING Barings said:
"The level of Telecom was quite low and it was expected that it would go up...everybody wanted to be long and everybody bought it."
Komercni Banka gained 67 crowns to 2,600, CEZ rose 15 crowns to 1,105, and Ceska Sportitelna gainedn one crown to 319.
